title: nice but heavy
text: nice but heavy. VERY heavy  .. i bought this to frame a pic to send to a friend  in Iowa  ... im in NY  the glass is WAY toooo heavy to ship  im shocked it got here in one piece since it wasnt secured in any way shape or form in the box  .... but it'll cost me a fortune to mail it so im gonna try and sell this here to someone in a yard sale and find something without glass in it

product_metadata.title: Kiera Grace Matted Classic Langford Picture Frame, 10" x 10", Black
features: Measurement: With opening dimensions of 10" x 10", hold one 5" x 5" photo using the acid-free mat to display your memories in this timeless picture frame
Material: Made with lightweight and smoothly-finished manufactured wood (MDF) for an elegant and minimal picture frame to house your pictures beautifully
Design: You’ll receive many compliments with this picture frame as its simple, classic aesthetic will match any home, room, or office décor effortlessly
Display: Use this decorative picture frame's easy-to-place horizontal & vertical triangle hangers to mount it onto any wall in your home, room, or office
Glass Front: Picture frame's glass front protects photos and prints from wear, stains, moisture, dust, and other damage to maintain long-lasting quality
Feature: Small attached fasteners on the picture frame's back offer easy photo replacement as its simple use allows you to swap prints quickly and easily
